title: Santo André's Weather Forecast Today
subtitle: Sunny with clouds and temperatures around 29°C
excerpt: Santo André's weather today features sun with many clouds and temperatures reaching up to 29ºC. The evening will remain heavily overcast.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The latest update from Climatempo indicates that Santo André will have a day of sun mixed with many clouds, keeping the temperature around 29ºC. At night, clouds accumulate and the temperature drops to 18ºC.

How the weather is today in Santo André

During the morning, the sky remains clear, but with many scattered clouds. In the afternoon, the sun continues to be present, but cloud cover increases, maintaining a comfortable thermal sensation. At night, the region becomes covered with clouds and the temperature drops to 18ºC.

Maximum and Minimum Forecasted Temperatures

  • Maximum: 29ºC
  • Minimum: 18ºC

Weekend Forecast for Grande ABC

Saturday (29) will be hot and stable throughout Grande ABC, with no rain expected. Minimum temperatures will range between 21°C and 22°C, while maximums could reach 33°C in São Caetano.

Temperatures in Santo André and neighboring cities

  • Santo André: minimum 22°C, maximum 32°C
  • São Bernardo: 22°C to 31°C
  • São Caetano: 22°C to 33°C
  • Diadema: 22°C to 31°C
  • Mauá: 22°C to 32°C
  • Ribeirão Pires: 21°C to 31°C
  • Rio Grande da Serra: 21°C to 31°C

What to expect for the evening and Monday

On Monday evening, the region remains cloudy, with no rain expected. Tuesday morning (1) brings sun with many clouds and a chance of rain in the early hours, followed by thunderstorms in the afternoon and rain late at night.

How to track the forecast in real-time

For those who need constant updates, the G1 app offers real-time weather news, including alerts and forecast changes. Climatempo provides the data that feeds the report, and the information may be updated as new meteorological conditions arise.

Summary of weather conditions for Santo André

  1. Day with sun and many clouds; maximum temperature 29ºC.
  2. Cloudy night; minimum temperature 18ºC.
  3. Saturday hot and stable; maximums up to 33ºC in São Caetano.
  4. Tuesday with sun and clouds, chance of rain in the morning and thunderstorms in the afternoon.

Stay alert to weather changes

The forecast may change as new information becomes available. Should there be relevant alterations, the report will be updated. If you notice any error, please contact G1 via the form available on the website.
